subject.title: Browserbase integration broken: static cdpUrl returns 404, needs session API

question: Should OpenClaw accept a first-party Browserbase session driver/config surface now, route this through a generic browser backend plugin seam, or narrow the current fix to docs/workarounds until that product direction is settled?
rationale: The fix is not only a code repair: it defines credential handling, provider-specific session lifecycle, and whether a commercial browser service belongs in bundled browser runtime or a plugin/API seam.

options.title: Adopt A Revised Browserbase Driver
options.body: Review and repair the existing Browserbase driver PR or a successor after approving the credential/session contract and requiring redacted live browser-tool proof.

options.title: Route Through Generic Backend API
options.body: Keep this issue linked to the browser backend plugin interface and require the Browserbase implementation to ship as a plugin once the seam exists.

options.title: Docs-Only For Now
options.body: Remove or qualify the broken static Browserbase instructions and document manual session creation while deferring runtime support.

recommendation.title: Adopt A Revised Browserbase Driver
recommendation.body: Review and repair the existing Browserbase driver PR or a successor after approving the credential/session contract and requiring redacted live browser-tool proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent browser ownership work on the same bundled-plugin/config surface and is the strongest routing candidate for the product-boundary decision.
